# Quarterly Code Audit Checklist

- [ ] Run static analysis (flake8, pylint, bandit)
- [ ] Review for security vulnerabilities
- [ ] Check for code duplication
- [ ] Review naming and formatting conventions
- [ ] Update dependencies (pip list --outdated)
- [ ] Review and update requirements.txt
- [ ] Run all tests (pytest --cov)
- [ ] Add tests for new features
- [ ] Review and refactor repeated logic
- [ ] Document all new/changed APIs
- [ ] Peer review for all major changes
- [ ] Schedule next audit date
